en.title: World's End, Magic, and Scientific Love II —Rebirth—
en.premise: Three years after her execution, Luna awakens from a stone-like slumber, but she is no longer the person she once was. Having witnessed the lives and the suffering of those she once sought to destroy, she encounters Artlar, a man beginning a new life, and Celestia, who is determined to protect him. If a villain repents, can everything be forgiven?

zh.title: 世界毁灭、魔法与科学之恋 II ―Rebirth―
zh.premise: 处刑三年后，从石之沉睡中苏醒的露娜，已不再是曾经的她。在目睹了自己曾试图夺走的生命与痛苦后，她与开启了新生活的阿特勒，以及誓要守护他的塞莱斯蒂亚再次相遇。如果恶人改邪归正，一切真的都能被原谅吗？
